105800.name: The Kalveh Gatehouse

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Gravel Road.

105800.description:
The Kalveh Gatehouse squats astride the gravel road, a low tower of grey
fieldstone with its portcullis cranked up and its timber gates standing
open. Moss furs the lower courses, and a baron's banner, faded to the
colour of old wine, hangs limp from a pole above the arch. The way north
passes under the vault toward the edge of the great forest, while the
gravel road runs on south into the baron's lands. Wheel ruts and
hoofprints churn the mud under the arch.

105801.name: Gravel Road

north.description: To the north lies The Kalveh Gatehouse.

south.description: To the south lies Gravel Road.

105801.description:
Gravel crunches underfoot on a road laid straight and kept in good
repair, ditched on either side and edged with rough stone markers.
Hedgerows of hawthorn bound the way, and beyond them fields of barley
roll off in the breeze. The gatehouse lies behind you to the north, and
the road carries on south between the hedges. The air smells of cut hay
and wet earth.

105802.name: Gravel Road

north.description: To the north lies Gravel Road.

south.description: To the south lies Gravel Road.

105802.description:
The road dips here to meet a rill that crosses it in a shallow ford, its
bed paved with flat river stones so that cart wheels do not bog. Alder
saplings lean over the water, and silt lies scattered across the gravel
on the far side. Fields of turned earth stretch away to either hand,
dark and ready for planting. The road runs back north the way you came
and on south into the green country.

105803.name: Gravel Road

north.description: To the north lies Gravel Road.

south.description: To the south lies Gravel Road at the Settlement.

105803.description:
Rooftops and chimney smoke show ahead where the road draws near the
settlement, and the farmland gives way to kitchen gardens and low walls
of piled stone. A leaning post bears an unlit tin lantern, and a hand-
painted board beneath it points travellers on toward the town. The
gravel is packed hard here by years of carts. North the road leads back
toward the gatehouse, and south it enters the settlement.

105804.name: Gravel Road at the Settlement

north.description: To the north lies Gravel Road.

east.description: To the east lies Towne Road.

south.description: To the south lies Gravel Road.

105804.description:
The gravel road widens into a muddy junction at the edge of the
settlement, where a lane of beaten earth turns off east into Towne Road.
Timber-framed cottages with steep thatched roofs crowd close, and a well
with a mossy stone curb stands on the corner, its bucket chain rattling
in the wind. Smoke curls from a dozen chimneys. The road runs on south
between rail fences, and back north it leads toward the gatehouse.

105805.name: Gravel Road

north.description: To the north lies Gravel Road at the Settlement.

south.description: To the south lies Gravel Road.

105805.description:
The gravel road runs south past the last cottages, and open pasture
rolls away on both sides behind walls of grey stacked stone. A stile of
two worn steps crosses the wall at one point, and a milestone lettered
with the baron's mark leans in the verge. Cart wheels have cut the
gravel into twin troughs. The settlement lies back north, and the road
goes on south.

105806.name: Gravel Road

north.description: To the north lies Gravel Road.

south.description: To the south lies Gravel Road.

105806.description:
Willow and elder crowd a damp ditch at the roadside here, and the gravel
is scattered with their small leaves. Posts of split oak march beside
the road, strung with rusty wire, and a haystack under a thatched cap
stands in a field. The wind brings a faint churning sound from far off,
like a mill. The road runs north toward the settlement and south onward.

105807.name: Gravel Road

north.description: To the north lies Gravel Road.

east.description: To the east lies Gravel Road.

105807.description:
The road turns here, bending off east around the corner of a ploughed
field, and a crooked signpost marks the turning with arms bleached too
pale to read. Furrows of rich brown soil run away in straight lines, and
a scarecrow of sacking and sticks stands guard over them in a flapping
coat. North the road returns toward the settlement, and east it bends
on.

105808.name: Gravel Road

south.description: To the south lies Bend in the Gravel Road.

west.description: To the west lies Gravel Road.

105808.description:
A tall hedge of blackthorn walls the road on one side, thick with dark
sloes, and a shallow ditch of brown water runs along its foot. The road
swings here from the west and turns south toward a further bend. Pale
dust lifts from the gravel at each footfall and settles slowly again.

105809.name: Bend in the Gravel Road

north.description: To the north lies Gravel Road.

east.description: To the east lies Bend in the Gravel Road.

105809.description:
A lone ash tree stands at the elbow of this bend in the gravel road, and
its roots have heaved the verge into a low mound. Carters have worn a
pale path around its trunk where they swing their wagons wide. The road
comes down from the north and curves away east, and the smell of hay and
manure drifts along it from further on.

105810.name: Bend in the Gravel Road

south.description: To the south lies Before a Large Barn.

west.description: To the west lies Bend in the Gravel Road.

105810.description:
The road curves again, swinging in from the west to run south toward a
large barn whose red roof shows above a stand of poplars. Puddles fill
the ruts, and the gravel is darkened with old straw dragged out by
wheels. A fence of whitewashed rails begins here and follows the road.
The air is thick with the scent of dung and hay.

105811.name: Before a Large Barn

north.description: To the north lies Bend in the Gravel Road.

east.description: To the east lies West of the Tower.

south.description: To the south lies Scrupulously Clean Barn.

105811.description:
A large barn of weathered red boards towers over a yard of trampled
earth, its double doors slid back on rusted tracks. Straw and spilled
grain mark the ground, and a water trough hollowed from a single log
stands by the wall. The road leads north back to the bend, and a lane
runs east to the baron's tower, whose dark bulk looms above the
roofline. The barn's open doors face south.

105812.name: West of the Tower

east.description: To the east lies Before the Tower.

west.description: To the west lies Before a Large Barn.

105812.description:
A track of packed earth runs on toward the baron's tower, its bulk
rising dark and unlovely over the roofs of sheds and byres. The grass
along the verge has been cut short and the hedges clipped hard, as
though some stern eye insisted on it. A rusty lantern pole stands here
without a lantern. The track runs east toward the tower and west back to
the barn yard.

105813.name: Before the Tower

east.description: To the east lies The Tower Entry Gate.

west.description: To the west lies West of the Tower.

105813.description:
The lane widens into a bare yard of swept flagstones, and the keep rises
sheer above it, black-grey stone studded with narrow slit windows. The
ivy clinging to the walls has died to a brittle brown, and no bird sings
here. A cold breath seems to come off the masonry. The gate lies east,
and west the lane leads back toward the barn.

105814.name: The Tower Entry Gate

east.description: To the east lies Entryway Into the Main Hall.

west.description: To the west lies Before the Tower.

105814.description:
An arched gateway of iron-bound oak stands in the tower's base, and over
it the baron's arms are cut deep in the stone: a tower between two
crescents. Twin braziers burn low on either side of the door, and the
flagstones before it are worn to hollows by countless feet. The great
door east stands ajar on a dark entry, and the lane leads back west.

105815.name: Scrupulously Clean Barn

north.description: To the north lies Before a Large Barn.

south.description: To the south lies The Pastures.

105815.description:
The Scrupulously Clean Barn has a floor swept bare and stalls scrubbed
with lye until the boards are nearly white. Tools hang in neat order on
pegs, and bales of hay are stacked square against the walls. Light falls
in long gold bars through slits in the planking and shows not a mote of
dust. The barn doors open north to the yard, and an inner door leads
south to the pastures.

105816.name: The Pastures

north.description: To the north lies Scrupulously Clean Barn.

east.description: To the east lies The Pastures.

west.description: To the west lies The Pastures.

105816.description:
A wide meadow opens here behind the barn, the grass cropped short and
bright green, with a stout rail fence marking its edges. A trough of
rainwater stands by the barn wall, ringed with trampled mud. The sky is
large and the breeze smells of clover. The barn door lies north, and the
pasture continues east and west.

105817.name: The Pastures

west.description: To the west lies The Pastures.

105817.description:
The pasture rises to a low mound here where a pair of old oaks cast
broad shade, and the grass beneath them is flattened in rings. A rotting
gate lies in the long grass, half-sunk. Buttercups dot the slope and the
air hums with insects. The pasture slopes back west toward the barn.

105818.name: The Pastures

east.description: To the east lies The Pastures.

105818.description:
This end of the pasture is boggy and ill-drained, a place of rushes and
trampled mud where the grass gives way to dark puddles. A fence of
leaning rails marks the edge of the baron's land, and a battered bucket
lies on its side. The wind moves the rushes in long whispers. The
pasture lies back east toward the barn.

105819.name: Towne Road

east.description: To the east lies Intersection on Towne Road.

west.description: To the west lies Gravel Road at the Settlement.

105819.description:
Towne Road is a lane of packed clay, rutted by cart wheels and edged
with plank walkways raised above the mud. Cottage gables lean over it,
window boxes crowded with marigolds and kale. Scrapings of boot-mud mark
every doorstep, and a rusted horseshoe is nailed over one lintel for
luck. The road runs east toward a wider crossing, and west it meets the
gravel road.

105820.name: Intersection on Towne Road

north.description: To the north lies Towne Road.

east.description: To the east lies Towne Road.

south.description: To the south lies Towne Road.

west.description: To the west lies Towne Road.

105820.description:
Four lanes meet at a crossing paved with round cobbles, the only paving
for some distance. A gnawed hitching rail stands against one corner, and
a notice board beside it hangs with bare pegs where papers once were
pinned. Iron brackets on the corner walls hold lanterns for the evening.
Towne Road leads north between cottages, east toward the heart of the
town, south toward a school, and west back to the gravel road.

105821.name: Towne Road

north.description: To the north lies Towne Road.

east.description: To the east lies Cozy Home.

south.description: To the south lies Intersection on Towne Road.

west.description: To the west lies Quiet Home.

105821.description:
The lane runs between two small cottages whose doors face each other
across it, one painted green and the other a faded blue. Doorsteps are
scrubbed white, and a boot scraper of bent iron waits beside each. A
wash line sags across the lane, hung with linen that snaps in the wind.
The east door opens on a cozy home and the west door on a quiet one,
while the lane goes on north and back south to the crossing.

105822.name: Towne Road

north.description: To the north lies Cul-de-sac.

east.description: To the east lies Small Log Home.

south.description: To the south lies Towne Road.

west.description: To the west lies Simple Home.

105822.description:
Here the lane narrows between a house of squared logs and a plain
cottage of whitewashed plaster. Rain barrels stand at their corners, and
a woodpile stacked to the eaves fills the gap beside the log house. A
cart wheel with a broken spoke leans on a fence as though forgotten. A
door east leads into the log home and one west into the simple cottage,
and the lane continues north to a dead end and south toward the
crossing.

105823.name: Cul-de-sac

north.description: To the north lies Simple Home.

east.description: To the east lies Thatch-Roofed Home.

south.description: To the south lies Towne Road.

west.description: To the west lies Small Home.

105823.description:
The lane ends in a small circle of trampled earth ringed by three homes
with their doors turned inward. A well-head of dry stone stands in the
middle, capped with a wooden lid and roped shut against children. Faded
chalk marks for some game cross the ground by the south mouth of the
lane. Doors open north, east and west, and the lane leads back south to
Towne Road.

105824.name: Simple Home

south.description: To the south lies Cul-de-sac.

105824.description:
A single plain room serves this whole household, its plaster walls bare
apart from a row of pegs for coats. A straw-tick bed sits in one corner
under a patched quilt, and a table with two stools stands beneath the
shuttered window. The hearth is swept clean and a blackened kettle hangs
from its hook. The door south leads back out to the cul-de-sac.

105825.name: Towne Road

north.description: To the north lies Intersection on Towne Road.

east.description: To the east lies Freshly-Painted Home.

south.description: To the south lies Schoolhouse Square.

west.description: To the west lies Empty Home.

105825.description:
Towne Road runs south from the crossing between a freshly painted house
on the east side and a boarded cottage on the west, whose door hangs
half open. Whitewash drips have dried in streaks on the stones outside
the painted house, and a ladder lies abandoned in its yard. Weeds grow
between the cobbles in front of the empty one. The road leads north to
the crossing and south to a small square.

105826.name: Schoolhouse Square

north.description: To the north lies Towne Road.

east.description: To the east lies Tidy Home.

south.description: To the south lies Ye Olde School.

west.description: To the west lies Small Home.

105826.description:
A small square of beaten earth lies before the schoolhouse, its ground
scuffed bare by running feet. A hopscotch grid is scratched in one
corner, and a bell on a bracket by the school door waits for its rope to
be pulled. Two homes face each other across the open ground, one tidy to
the east and one small to the west. The school stands south, and Towne
Road leads back north.

105827.name: Ye Olde School

north.description: To the north lies Schoolhouse Square.

105827.description:
Rows of narrow desks with inkwells face a raised master's table in this
old schoolroom, and a slate hangs on the wall still marked with half-
erased sums. Letters of the alphabet are painted around the ceiling in
faded red, and a cane rests on two hooks above the chalk-dusty
blackboard. Sunlight slants through tall windows onto the boards. The
door north leads out to the square.

105828.name: Small Home

east.description: To the east lies Schoolhouse Square.

105828.description:
Barely more than a room with a bed, this small home is crowded with a
loom that fills most of the floor. Half-woven cloth in blue and grey is
stretched across it, and spools of thread sit in a basket by the stool.
A pair of clogs waits beside the door. The door east leads back to
Schoolhouse Square.

105829.name: Tidy Home

west.description: To the west lies Schoolhouse Square.

105829.description:
Everything in this home has a place and is in it: cups hang by their
handles from a rack, boots stand in a neat pair by the door, and a rug
has been brushed until its pattern shows. A tall clock stands in one
corner, its pendulum swinging evenly. The hearth is blackleaded to a
shine. The door west opens onto Schoolhouse Square.

105830.name: Empty Home

east.description: To the east lies Towne Road.

105830.description:
No one has lived in this home for a long time, and dust lies thick on
the table and the mantel. The shutters are nailed shut over the windows,
and a few sticks of broken furniture are pushed against one wall. An old
nest of dried mud clings above the lintel. Light enters only through the
door east, which opens on Towne Road.

105831.name: Freshly-Painted Home

west.description: To the west lies Towne Road.

105831.description:
The smell of fresh paint fills this home, so sharp that the shutters
have been propped wide. Everything is new and bright: a yellow-washed
wall, a table scrubbed pale, and a bed with a quilt still creased from
its folds. A pot of brushes soaks in a bucket by the hearth. The door
west leads back to Towne Road.

105832.name: Quiet Home

east.description: To the east lies Towne Road.

105832.description:
Hush lies on this house like a blanket, for the thick walls shut out the
lane and the only sound is a clock ticking on its shelf. A rocking chair
stands unmoving by a shuttered window with a folded shawl over its arm.
Pale light filters through the slats onto a scrubbed floor. The door
east gives onto Towne Road.

105833.name: Simple Home

east.description: To the east lies Towne Road.

105833.description:
Plain furnishings fill this house: a trestle table, two benches and a
dresser of blue-glazed plates. Sacking curtains hang across a sleeping
alcove, and a broom leans in the corner near the cold hearth. Sunlight
from a small window lays a bright square on the floor. The door east
returns to Towne Road.

105834.name: Small Home

east.description: To the east lies Cul-de-sac.

105834.description:
This tiny cottage is scarcely wide enough for the narrow cot against the
wall and the chest at its foot. A candle stub burns in a dish on the
sill, and a rag rug covers the boards. A mended basket and a bundle of
kindling hang from hooks beside the door. The door east opens onto the
cul-de-sac.

105835.name: Thatch-Roofed Home

west.description: To the west lies Cul-de-sac.

105835.description:
Bundles of reed show through the ceiling where the thatch has been laid
thick over the rafters, giving the room a dry grassy smell. A spinning
wheel waits beside the hearth with a hank of grey wool wound upon it,
and herbs hang drying from the beams. The floor is beaten earth strewn
with rushes. The door west opens back onto the cul-de-sac.

105836.name: Small Log Home

west.description: To the west lies Towne Road.

105836.description:
Round logs chinked with moss and clay make the walls of this snug home,
and the smell of resin still lingers in the wood. A ladder-backed chair
sits by an iron stove, and a shelf of crockery runs along the wall. A
hunting bow hangs on two pegs above the door. The only way out is the
door west, onto Towne Road.

105837.name: Cozy Home

west.description: To the west lies Towne Road.

105837.description:
A fire crackles in the hearth of this cozy home, and a deep armchair
with a worn cushion sits beside it. Embroidered cloths cover the table
and the mantel, and a pot of stew simmers on its hook above the coals.
Dried flowers hang in bunches from the rafters. The door west opens on
Towne Road.

105838.name: Towne Road

east.description: To the east lies Towne Road.

west.description: To the west lies Intersection on Towne Road.

105838.description:
The road here runs between shopfronts and workshops with their shutters
thrown up for trade, and the packed clay is stained and pitted from hard
use. A signboard creaks overhead on its chains, painted with a faded
plough. Smells of baking drift along the lane from somewhere out of
sight. The road leads east toward the square and west back to the
crossing.

105839.name: Town Square

north.description: To the north lies Towne Road.

east.description: To the east lies A Colorful Park.

south.description: To the south lies Towne Road.

west.description: To the west lies Towne Road.

105839.description:
The square is a broad cobbled space with a stone fountain at its centre,
its basin green with age and its spout dribbling a thin stream. Market
stalls with sagging canvas awnings stand around the edge, waiting for
the next market day. Towne Road leads away north and south, a park opens
east beneath its trees, and the road west runs back toward the crossing.
Whitewash and moss streak the fountain's rim.

105840.name: Towne Road

north.description: To the north lies Northern Square.

east.description: To the east lies Salaylia's Diner.

south.description: To the south lies Town Square.

west.description: To the west lies The Herbalist.

105840.description:
A short street of low shops, with the smell of frying onions pouring
from the diner on the east side and a sharper, greener scent from the
herbalist's door on the west. Bundles of dried lavender swing from a
hook over the herbalist's step, and a chalkboard by the diner lists the
day's dishes in tidy script. The road runs north into a smaller square
and south to the great square.

105841.name: Northern Square

north.description: To the north lies The Apothecary.

east.description: To the east lies The Town Clinic.

south.description: To the south lies Towne Road.

west.description: To the west lies Smithy.

105841.description:
A small square paved with worn flagstones lies at the head of the
street, with three doors opening off it: an apothecary's to the north, a
clinic to the east and a smithy to the west. A pump with an iron handle
stands in the middle, and the ring of hammer blows carries from the
smithy. Soot streaks the walls on the west side. The street leads south
toward the town square.

105842.name: The Apothecary

south.description: To the south lies Northern Square.

105842.description:
Shelves of stoppered jars and glass bottles climb the walls of this
narrow shop, each labelled in a tiny cramped hand. A counter scarred
with acid stains holds brass scales and a mortar of dark stone, and the
air is thick with camphor and clove. Dried roots hang in bunches near
the ceiling. The way out is south, to the square.

105843.name: The Town Clinic

west.description: To the west lies Northern Square.

105843.description:
Clean linen and the sting of vinegar greet you in this whitewashed
clinic. Narrow cots stand in a row beneath high windows, each made up
with a grey blanket, and a table by the wall is laid with clamps, thread
and bandages. A basin of steaming water sits by the door. West is the
way out onto the square.

105844.name: Smithy

east.description: To the east lies Northern Square.

105844.description:
The forge glows red at the back of this soot-black workshop, and a great
bellows hangs wheezing beside it. An anvil scarred by years of hammering
squats in the middle of the floor, ringed with tongs, punches and half-
finished horseshoes. Heat shimmers over the quenching trough. A door
east opens back onto the square.

105845.name: Salaylia's Diner

west.description: To the west lies Towne Road.

105845.description:
Salaylia's Diner is a warm low room of mismatched tables and benches
worn smooth by elbows. A long counter runs along one wall, and behind it
a hatch opens on a kitchen where pans clatter and something savoury
bubbles. Tin lamps on the beams sway in the draught from the door. The
only way out is west, to the road.

105846.name: The Herbalist

east.description: To the east lies Towne Road.

105846.description:
Every beam and rafter of the herbalist's shop sags with drying bundles
of leaf and flower, and the floor is cluttered with baskets of fresh-cut
roots. A potted bay tree stands by the window, and a low table holds a
ledger and a clay pot of ink. The smell is green and bitter and
strangely soothing. The door east returns to the road.

105847.name: A Colorful Park

north.description: To the north lies A Shady Path.

east.description: To the east lies The Towne Hall.

west.description: To the west lies Town Square.

105847.description:
Flower beds blaze in reds, golds and violets across this little park,
bordered with clipped box hedges and shaded by old maples. Gravel paths
wind between benches carved with the names of long-dead sweethearts. A
shady path leads north under arching boughs into the wood, the Towne
Hall stands to the east, and the square lies back west. Fallen petals
drift across the paths.

105848.name: The Towne Hall

west.description: To the west lies A Colorful Park.

105848.description:
The settlement's folk gather in this timbered hall to argue and settle
accounts, and the high raftered ceiling swallows their voices. A long
council table, scuffed and inkstained, runs the length of the floor, and
a tattered banner of the baron's house hangs behind the reeve's chair.
Benches line the walls beside a cabinet stuffed with rolled tax rolls.
The door west leads out to the park.

105849.name: The Tailor's

east.description: To the east lies Towne Road.

105849.description:
Bolts of wool, linen and dyed canvas lean against the walls of the
tailor's shop, and a dressmaker's wooden form stands pinned in the
middle of the floor. A long table carries shears, chalk and a tray of
bone buttons, and a tape hangs from a nail beside the shuttered window.
The floor is strewn with snippets of thread. A door in the east wall
opens onto Towne Road.

105850.name: Towne Road

north.description: To the north lies Town Square.

east.description: To the east lies House of Worship.

south.description: To the south lies Southern Square.

west.description: To the west lies The Tailor's.

105850.description:
Towne Road passes here between a plain-fronted house of worship and a
tailor's shop, where bolts of cloth hang in the window like banners. A
scrap of faded ribbon is nailed beside the tailor's door as his sign,
and a stone step worn hollow by many feet leads up to the worship house
on the east side. The road leads north to the great square, south to a
smaller one, and west through the tailor's door.

105851.name: House of Worship

west.description: To the west lies Towne Road.

105851.description:
A plain hall of whitewashed walls and dark beams, its benches set in
rows before a low altar of grey stone. Candles in iron stands burn at
either side, and light falls in coloured bars through one narrow window
of stained glass. The air is cool and smells of wax and old incense. The
door west opens to the road.

105852.name: The General Store

east.description: To the east lies Southern Square.

105852.description:
Shelves reach from floor to rafters in the General Store, crowded with
rope, lamp oil, tin pans, nails and bolts of coarse cloth. A counter of
scarred pine holds a ledger and a brass bell, and a barrel of pickled
herring stands by the door. Boots, hats and sacks of meal hang from
hooks overhead. The door east returns to the square.

105853.name: Southern Square

north.description: To the north lies Towne Road.

east.description: To the east lies The Distillery.

south.description: To the south lies Town Gardens.

west.description: To the west lies The General Store.

105853.description:
A neat cobbled square, smaller than the great one, where carts pause to
unload sacks and barrels. A rack of barrel staves stands against one
wall, and the sour-sweet smell of mash hangs over everything from the
distillery doorway east. A general store with a hanging lantern fills
the west side, and a gated way south leads into gardens. The road leads
back north toward the town square.

105854.name: The Distillery

west.description: To the west lies Southern Square.

105854.description:
Two squat copper stills dominate the Distillery, their coiled pipes
dripping slowly into oaken tubs. Barrels in tall stacks line the walls,
branded with the baron's mark, and the air is heavy and sweet enough to
make the eyes water. A ladder leans against a mash vat crusted with
grain. The only way out is the door west, onto the square.

105855.name: Town Gardens

north.description: To the north lies Southern Square.

105855.description:
Walled beds of cabbages, beans and onions fill the Town Gardens in tidy
rows, each plot marked by a stick with a scrap of coloured rag. A
trellis hung with climbing peas shades a bench of weathered planks, and
a rain butt stands at the corner of a toolshed. The soil is dark and
freshly hoed, and the smell of crushed mint rises underfoot. A gap in
the wall leads out north to the square.

105856.name: Entryway Into the Main Hall

east.description: To the east lies Main Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Tower Entry Gate.

105856.description:
A cold, narrow entry hall with a floor of black flags and a vaulted
ceiling hung with iron lanterns. Coat pegs line one wall, though no
coats hang there, and the rushes underfoot smell of tallow and damp. A
pair of tall doors carved with thorns stands open east into a larger
hall, and the door west returns to the gate.

105857.name: Main Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Feasting Hall.

east.description: To the east lies Audience Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies Entryway Into the Main Hall.

105857.description:
The main hall is a long lofty chamber, its grey pillars hung with
banners of the barony gone brown with soot. A wide hearth on one side
holds a fire that gives more smoke than warmth, and high windows throw
dim bars of daylight across the floor. A doorway north leads to a
feasting hall, an arch east opens on an audience chamber, and the
entryway lies west.

105858.name: Audience Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Feasting Hall.

east.description: To the east lies Behind the Gilded Chair.

south.description: To the south lies Private Meeting Room.

west.description: To the west lies Main Hall.

105858.description:
A grand chamber of tall windows, with a dais at the far end whose steps
are carpeted in crimson worn to the thread. The Gilded Chair stands upon
it, its gold leaf peeling, facing a floor of chequered marble. Doors
lead north to the feasting hall and south to a private meeting room, an
arch opens west to the main hall, and a narrow door east lies behind the
dais.

105859.name: Behind the Gilded Chair

west.description: To the west lies Audience Chamber.

up.description: To the up lies Secret Staircase.

105859.description:
A narrow space is hidden behind the dais, curtained from the chamber by
heavy velvet that smells of age. The back of the Gilded Chair looms
overhead, bare wood without any gilding, and cobwebs hang in the
corners. A gap in the panelling reveals a tight stair rising up into
darkness. The door west leads back to the audience chamber.

105860.name: The Feasting Hall

south.description: To the south lies Audience Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Feasting Hall.

105860.description:
The far end of the feasting hall is raised on a shallow dais, where a
high seat carved with wolves faces down the length of the table. Tall
shuttered windows frame the dais, and a stale smell of old wine hangs in
the heavy curtains. Broken goblets are swept into a corner. A door south
opens on the audience chamber, and the hall stretches back west.

105861.name: The Feasting Hall

east.description: To the east lies The Feasting Hall.

south.description: To the south lies Main Hall.

105861.description:
A long table of black oak runs down the middle of this hall, set with
pewter plates and cold candlesticks laid for guests who never came.
Antler racks and hunting horns hang from the walls, and the great hearth
is swept clean and empty. Dust lies on the benches, undisturbed. The
hall goes on east, and a doorway south leads back to the main hall.

105862.name: Private Meeting Room

north.description: To the north lies Audience Chamber.

105862.description:
A small round table with four chairs stands in this meeting room, its
surface scarred by the knives and rings of long discussions. A tall
cabinet of ledgers stands against the wall, and a single narrow window
admits a pale slice of light. The walls are panelled in dark wood, and a
stale smell of pipe-smoke lingers. The only way out is north, to the
audience chamber.

105863.name: Secret Staircase

up.description: To the up lies Stone and Mortar Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies Behind the Gilded Chair.

105863.description:
A narrow spiral of worn steps winds through the thickness of the tower
wall, so tight that the shoulders brush mortar on both sides. A single
torch gutters in an iron ring, and its smoke blackens the low ceiling.
Scratch marks of countless hands have polished the rail. The stair leads
up toward the upper floors and down to the space behind the gilded
chair.

105864.name: Stone and Mortar Hallway

south.description: To the south lies Necromocis' Private Chambers.

west.description: To the west lies Stone and Mortar Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies Secret Staircase.

105864.description:
Rough mortar and unpolished stone line this hallway, and the chill here
is a different cold from the damp of the lower rooms. Wall sconces hold
black candles, and their flames lean toward the doors. A heavy door
south bears a sign of crossed bones, and the hall continues west. A
stair leads down to the secret spiral.

105865.name: Stone and Mortar Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Gilzaan's Private Chambers.

east.description: To the east lies Stone and Mortar Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies End of the Hall.

105865.description:
The hallway bends here, and the air carries a sharp odour of sulphur
from the door to the north. Black stains streak the mortar around its
frame, and the floor before it is scorched in a pale circle. Torches
burn in brackets, smoking. The hall runs east to the stairhead and west
to its end.

105866.name: End of the Hall

east.description: To the east lies Stone and Mortar Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Sitting Room.

105866.description:
The hall ends in a blank wall hung with a faded tapestry of a stag hunt,
its colours dulled by smoke. A narrow bench stands beneath it, and a
cracked bowl of dried petals perfumes the corner with a lost summer.
Drafts rattle a loose shutter somewhere overhead. A hall runs back east,
and a door west leads into a sitting room.

105867.name: Gilzaan's Private Chambers

south.description: To the south lies Stone and Mortar Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Gilzaan's Private Chambers.

105867.description:
Glass tubes, brass funnels and bell jars crowd the benches of this
chamber, and a rack of stoppered phials glints in the light of a green-
shaded lamp. The floor is scrubbed in patches, as though something
spilled there and was hastily wiped away. Charts of the human frame,
inked in red, are pinned to every wall. The door south opens on the
hallway, and an archway leads west to a back room.

105868.name: Gilzaan's Private Chambers

east.description: To the east lies Gilzaan's Private Chambers.

105868.description:
This back room holds a high narrow table with leather straps hanging
from its sides, and a trough beneath it drains through a slot in the
floor. Shelves of jars hold pale shapes floating in murky spirits, and
the smell of vinegar and iron lies thick on the air. A stool and a tray
of surgeon's saws wait beside the table. Nothing else leads from the
room but the archway east.

105869.name: Necromocis' Private Chambers

east.description: To the east lies Necromocis' Private Chambers.

105869.description:
The inner room is small and cold, with a narrow cot made up in grey
sheets and a cabinet of tinctures standing open. A mirror on the wall
has been turned face to the plaster, and a bowl of black water sits
untouched on the sill. Something has been scratched into the floorboards
in a circle. The only way out is east, to the outer chambers.

105870.name: Necromocis' Private Chambers

north.description: To the north lies Stone and Mortar Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Necromocis' Private Chambers.

105870.description:
Black drapes cover the windows of these chambers, and a ring of pale
candles burns upon a table scattered with charts and bone-handled
knives. Shelves line the walls, crowded with skulls arranged by size,
and a sweet, faint rot underlies the incense. A great open book lies on
a reading stand. The door north returns to the hallway, and an inner
room lies west.

105871.name: Sitting Room

north.description: To the north lies Bathing Area.

east.description: To the east lies End of the Hall.

south.description: To the south lies Kalveh's Private Chambers.

up.description: To the up lies Runed Staircase.

105871.description:
This sitting room is warm and well kept, with two deep chairs drawn up
before a hearth and a rug of dark red wool between them. A carved
cabinet of decanters stands against the wall, and a lamp with a painted
shade casts a gentle gold glow. Doors open north to a bathing area and
south to private chambers, and a hall lies back east. A stair of runed
stone climbs up from the corner.

105872.name: Kalveh's Private Chambers

north.description: To the north lies Sitting Room.

east.description: To the east lies Kalveh's Private Chambers.

105872.description:
The baron's private chambers open here with a great four-post bed hung
with curtains of dark green velvet. A writing desk stands by the window,
its surface strewn with letters sealed in black wax and a seal-ring
pressed in a dish. A tall mirror in a gilt frame reflects the room, a
little dimmer than the room itself. A door leads north to the sitting
room, and the chambers extend east.

105873.name: Kalveh's Private Chambers

west.description: To the west lies Kalveh's Private Chambers.

down.description: To the down lies Secret Staircase.

105873.description:
A wardrobe of black oak, a trunk bound with brass and a rack of heavy
cloaks fill the inner part of the baron's chambers. A carved panel
beside the wardrobe stands slightly out of true, and a draught rises
from behind it with the smell of cold air. The floor around it is worn
to a bright path. The chambers continue back west, and a hidden stair
leads down behind the panel.

105874.name: Bathing Area

south.description: To the south lies Sitting Room.

105874.description:
A deep copper tub stands on clawed feet in the middle of the bathing
area, a folded towel draped over its rim. Steam from a kettle of hot
water clouds the mirror above a washstand, and sweet-smelling soaps lie
in a dish of blue glass. The floor tiles are warm underfoot, and a rack
holds fresh linen. The only way out is south, to the sitting room.

105875.name: Runed Staircase

up.description: To the up lies The Kalveh Laboratory.

down.description: To the down lies Sitting Room.

105875.description:
A narrow stair of black stone spirals up from the sitting room, its
steps cut with runes that glow faintly as you pass. The walls are smooth
and cold, and a thin humming comes from above. Candle-smoke has stained
the ceiling in a soft grey. The stair climbs up toward the laboratory
and descends back to the sitting room.

105876.name: The Kalveh Laboratory

east.description: To the east lies The Kalveh Laboratory.

south.description: To the south lies A Candle-Lit Study.

down.description: To the down lies Runed Staircase.

105876.description:
The laboratory fills a round chamber under the tower roof, and benches
ring its walls beneath hanging copper lamps. Retorts, alembics and long
glass coils crowd every surface, and some still bubble over beds of blue
flame. A scorched floor shows where past experiments went badly. The
laboratory continues east, a study opens south, and a runed stair
descends.

105877.name: The Kalveh Laboratory

south.description: To the south lies Artifact Room.

west.description: To the west lies The Kalveh Laboratory.

105877.description:
A great iron furnace squats at the heart of the lab, its mouth glowing
orange and its flue vanishing into the roof. Tongs, bellows and ladles
hang from a rail, and the floor is gritty with soot swept to one side.
The heat is fierce, and the air shimmers. The laboratory runs back west,
and a low door in the south wall leads to an artifact room.

105878.name: A Candle-Lit Study

north.description: To the north lies The Kalveh Laboratory.

south.description: To the south lies A Packed Library.

105878.description:
Candles by the dozen burn in iron holders around this study, and the wax
has run in long white drips on every desk. A great table is covered with
open books and unfinished letters, and a skull holds down a pile of
parchments. The smell of ink and tallow is strong. The study opens north
to the laboratory and south to a library.

105879.name: A Packed Library

north.description: To the north lies A Candle-Lit Study.

east.description: To the east lies The Kalveh Observatory.

105879.description:
Shelves rise to the ceiling in this packed library, bowed by the weight
of leather-bound books and rolled scrolls. A ladder on a rail runs the
length of the wall, and the aisles between the stacks are scarcely wide
enough for one reader. Dust motes drift in the light of a single window.
The study lies back north, and a short passage leads east to an
observatory.

105880.name: The Kalveh Observatory

west.description: To the west lies A Packed Library.

105880.description:
The observatory is a small round room under a dome of dark timber, with
a slot cut in its roof for a long brass tube set on a swivelling mount.
Star charts cover the walls, marked with crimson lines that converge on
one point. A stool and an inkwell wait beneath the instrument. The only
way out is west, to the library.

105881.name: Artifact Room

north.description: To the north lies The Kalveh Laboratory.

105881.description:
Glass cases line the walls of this small room, their locks of black
iron, each holding some strange relic: a skull inlaid with silver, a
tarnished crown, an iron hand. Dust has been wiped from the glass in
neat circles, as though the cases are opened often. A heavy brass
balance stands on a pedestal in the middle. The only way out is north,
to the laboratory.

105882.name: Towne Road

east.description: To the east lies Town Square.

west.description: To the west lies Towne Road.

105882.description:
Close to the square the road is cobbled at last, and the pavement rings
under boots and cart wheels. Tall narrow houses with slate roofs lean in
overhead, and a trough of carved stone stands against one wall, brimming
from a brass spout. A bell tolls somewhere in the town, flat and slow.
The square opens out east, and the road runs west the way you came.

105883.name: Secret Staircase

up.description: To the up lies Kalveh's Private Chambers.

down.description: To the down lies Secret Staircase.

105883.description:
A hidden stair drops steeply from the baron's chambers, its steps cut
narrow and slick with a sheen of damp. The walls are bare grey masonry,
and a hand rope of knotted hemp is the only rail. Faint hollow sounds
rise from below, a murmur that might be chanting. The stair leads up to
the chambers above and down into deeper darkness.

105884.name: Secret Staircase

north.description: To the north lies Passage to a Twilight Chamber.

up.description: To the up lies Secret Staircase.

105884.description:
The stair ends in a small landing, where the steps turn and the air
grows heavier and colder. An iron ring is set in the wall, holding a
torch that burns with a pale, steady flame and no smoke. The masonry is
damp, and dull marks have been scraped across it as if by nails. A
passage leads north, and the steps climb up the way you came.

105885.name: Passage to a Twilight Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Twilight Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies Secret Staircase.

105885.description:
The passage is low and bare, its walls lined with small niches that hold
stubs of candles burned down to wax. Ahead the light changes, going dim
and violet, as if the day were forever fading. Every footstep sounds
muffled and strangely close. The passage opens north into a great
chamber, and a landing lies south.

105886.name: The Twilight Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Twilight Chamber.

east.description: To the east lies The Twilight Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies Passage to a Twilight Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Twilight Chamber.

105886.description:
You stand at the edge of a vast chamber lit by a dim violet glow that
has no source. The floor is black polished glass, and your reflection
walks beneath your feet. Tall pillars of grey stone rise into a ceiling
lost in haze, and the air hums low. A passage returns south, and the
chamber stretches away north, east and west.

105887.name: The Twilight Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Twilight Chamber.

east.description: To the east lies The Twilight Chamber.

105887.description:
The edge of the chamber is quiet and dim, and the glass underfoot shows
only a pale blur of your own face. A tall rack of silver rods leans
against the wall, each tipped with a crystal that gives off a dull
violet gleam. The air smells faintly of burnt hair. The chamber extends
north and east from here.

105888.name: The Twilight Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Twilight Chamber.

east.description: To the east lies The Twilight Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies The Twilight Chamber.

105888.description:
Long black drapes hang from the pillars here, rippling in the thrumming
air, and in their folds the violet light turns to indigo. A carved stone
bench faces the wall, its seat worn smooth by long vigils. Tracks of
dust show where something heavy was dragged across the floor. The
chamber extends north and south, and opens east toward its centre.

105889.name: The Twilight Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Twilight Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Twilight Chamber.

105889.description:
Chalk marks cover the glass floor in a rough arc here, symbols and
numbers overwritten again and again until they are a grey smear. A stool
and a stand of rolled parchments stand at the edge of the arc, long
untouched. The haze is thin, and the air tastes of old coins. The
chamber stretches north and west from this corner.

105890.name: The Twilight Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Twilight Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies The Twilight Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Twilight Chamber.

105890.description:
A line of iron braziers stands cold along the wall, each filled with
white ash that stirs when you pass. The violet haze thickens near the
ceiling, making the pillars look unfinished. Silver lines in the floor
bend toward a pillar at the edge of the room. The chamber extends north
and south from here, and opens back west toward its centre.

105891.name: The Twilight Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Twilight Chamber.

east.description: To the east lies The Twilight Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies The Twilight Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Twilight Chamber.

105891.description:
The heart of the chamber is a wide circle of black glass inlaid with
silver lines, curved and branching like roots. Violet light pools here
and flickers as though at the bottom of deep water. The hum swells to a
thrum you feel in the teeth. The glass floor continues in every
direction, north, east, south and west.

105892.name: The Twilight Chamber

east.description: To the east lies The Twilight Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies The Twilight Chamber.

105892.description:
A wall of mirrors in black frames lines this corner, though every glass
has been cracked or turned to the plaster, and a single one shows a
different room entirely. The pillars close in, leaving a narrow way
between them. The hum is quieter here, almost soothing. The chamber
opens east toward its far side and south along the wall.

105893.name: The Twilight Chamber

east.description: To the east lies The Twilight Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies The Twilight Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Twilight Chamber.

105893.description:
A tall curtain of grey gauze hangs along the far wall, stirring in a
wind that does not blow anywhere else in the chamber. Behind it, shadows
seem to shift and gather, taller than any man. The glass floor is cold
even through boots. The chamber continues east and west along the wall,
and opens back south toward its centre.

105894.name: The Twilight Chamber

south.description: To the south lies The Twilight Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Twilight Chamber.

105894.description:
The corner of the chamber is crowded with shattered glass, swept into
heaps against the walls, and the pillars here are cracked from base to
capital. Silver lines in the floor end at a ragged hole, filled in with
black wax. The violet light is faintest in this place. The chamber lies
back south and west.

643600.name: farmhand farmer worker man
643600.long_desc: A weary farmhand leans on a pitchfork, staring blankly at the ground.
643600.description:
A sunburnt man in a patched smock, his hands cracked and his eyes
shadowed with sleeplessness. He glances often toward the tower and says
little.

643601.name: villager townsman woman man
643601.long_desc: A wary villager hurries along, eyes down and shoulders tight.
643601.description:
A plain, homespun-clad townsperson of the settlement, who carries a
basket and speaks little to strangers. They keep their voices low and
glance often at the dark tower.

643602.name: guard tower guard soldier
643602.long_desc: A grim tower guard stands watch, halberd planted and eyes hard.
643602.description:
A broad guard in a black-and-grey livery with the baron's tower on the
breast. His helm hides most of his face, and his halberd is notched with
use.

643603.name: cultist robed acolyte
643603.long_desc: A robed cultist mutters over a book, black sleeves smeared with ash.
643603.description:
A pale figure in a dark hooded robe stitched with silver thread, his
fingers stained with ink and something darker. His eyes are fixed and
unblinking.

643604.name: ghost twilight dusk-pale spirit
643604.long_desc: A dusk-pale ghost drifts across the glass, trailing violet mist.
643604.description:
A tall, translucent shape in the tatters of a robe, bound to the chamber
by whatever work the baron began. Its hollow eyes burn with faint violet
light.

643605.name: ogre stitched hulk brute
643605.long_desc: A stitched ogre hulks over the benches, seams of thread crossing its grey hide.
643605.description:
A towering brute sewn together from parts that were never meant to
match, one arm longer than the other. Black thread binds every seam, and
a dull glow lights its eyes.

643606.name: gilzaan adviser alchemist wizard
643606.long_desc: Gilzaan, the baron's adviser, bends over a table of knives and glass, whispering to himself.
643606.description:
A gaunt, bald man in a stained leather apron, his fingers long and
stained with chemicals. He looks up with the mild interest of a man
spared from boredom.

643607.name: baron kalveh lord
643607.short_desc: Baron Kalveh, lord of the fief
643607.long_desc: Baron Kalveh stands in the violet gloom, his hands wreathed in pale fire.
643607.description:
A tall, grey-haired lord in a black cloak clasped with a silver tower,
his face as handsome as a statue and as cold. The light of the chamber
bends toward him as he moves.

743600.name: halberd notched guard
743600.description: A long-hafted halberd with a black-grey blade, nicked from hard use. The baron's tower is stamped into its socket.

743601.name: robe cultist hooded dark
743601.room_desc: A hooded black robe lies crumpled here.
743601.description: A heavy robe of black wool stitched with silver thread in a pattern of crescents. It smells faintly of ash and old ink.

743602.name: shroud twilight violet cloak
743602.room_desc: A shimmering violet shroud lies here.
743602.description: A thin cloak woven of something that is not quite cloth, it deepens to indigo at the hem. It never seems to settle and moves like mist on the air.

743603.name: staff gilzaan ironwood alchemist
743603.room_desc: A stained ironwood staff lies here.
743603.description: A heavy staff of dark ironwood capped with a ball of tarnished brass. Chemical stains discolour its lower end.

743604.name: blade sword baron kalveh black
743604.room_desc: A long black blade lies here, cold to the eye.
743604.description: A long sword of dark metal with a pommel shaped like a tower, whose edge seems to drink the light. It is the finest weapon the fief has known, and it has seen terrible use.
